code: SELECT * FROM karyawan;
SELECT nama, gaji FROM karyawan;
SELECT nama, gaji FROM karyawan WHERE gaji > 4000;
SELECT nama, gaji FROM karyawan ORDER BY gaji DESC;
SELECT * FROM karyawan LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) as jumlah FROM karyawan;
SELECT DISTINCT departemen FROM karyawan;
SELECT departemen, COUNT(*) as jumlah FROM karyawan GROUP BY departemen;
SELECT departemen, COUNT(*) as jumlah FROM karyawan GROUP BY departemen HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
SELECT k.nama, p.nama_proyek FROM karyawan k INNER JOIN proyek p ON k.id = p.karyawan_id;
SELECT k.nama, p.nama_proyek FROM karyawan k LEFT JOIN proyek p ON k.id = p.karyawan_id;
SELECT nama FROM karyawan WHERE gaji > (SELECT AVG(gaji) FROM karyawan);
SELECT nama, gaji FROM karyawan WHERE gaji BETWEEN 3000 AND 5000 OR departemen IN ('IT', 'HR');
SELECT departemen, COUNT(*) as jumlah, AVG(gaji) as rata_gaji FROM karyawan GROUP BY departemen;
SELECT k1.nama, k2.nama as atasan FROM karyawan k1 LEFT JOIN karyawan k2 ON k1.atasan_id = k2.id;
SELECT nama, gaji, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gaji DESC) as ranking FROM karyawan;
WITH gaji_tinggi AS (SELECT * FROM karyawan WHERE gaji > 5000) SELECT * FROM gaji_tinggi;
SELECT nama, gaji, CASE WHEN gaji > 5000 THEN 'Tinggi' WHEN gaji > 3000 THEN 'Sedang' ELSE 'Rendah' END as kategori FROM karyawan;
SELECT k.nama, COUNT(p.id) as jumlah_proyek, AVG(p.durasi) as rata_durasi FROM karyawan k LEFT JOIN proyek p ON k.id = p.karyawan_id GROUP BY k.id, k.nama;
SELECT departemen, SUM(CASE WHEN gaji > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gaji_tinggi, SUM(CASE WHEN gaji <= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as gaji_rendah FROM karyawan GROUP BY departemen;
